trip.title: Bier Reisen 2027
trip.subtitle: Bruges to Bamberg to Bohemia and back through Bavaria

stops.name: Frankfurt am Main Airport
stops.note: Pick up the rental car on arrival, return it here on day 15.

stops.name: Bruges
stops.note: Historic centre, De Halve Maan, brown bars on the canal.

stops.name: Ghent
stops.note: Gruut, Dok Noord, Dulle Griet and the Waterhuis.

stops.name: Bamberg
stops.note: UNESCO old town, nine breweries, rauchbier capital.

stops.name: Pivovar Permon, Sokolov
stops.note: Mining-country craft brewery with its own restaurant and rooms.

stops.name: Plzeň
stops.note: Birthplace of pilsner, tank beer, Pilsner Urquell cellars.

stops.name: Kout na Šumavě
stops.address: Kout na Šumavě 2, 345 02 Kout na Šumavě, Czechia
stops.note: Cult 12° lager, revived 2006, deep in the Bohemian forest.

stops.name: Maxlrain Bierstube
stops.note: Schlossbrauerei Maxlrain, brewery inn south of Munich.

stops.name: Andechs / Herrsching
stops.note: Benedictine monastery brewery above the Ammersee; sleep in Herrsching.

stops.name: Munich
stops.note: Augustiner, Schneider, Giesinger, ORCA and the beer halls.

stops.name: Nuremberg
stops.note: Rotbier country: Altstadthof, Schanzenbräu, Tucher Mautkeller.

Bruges.name: De Halve Maan
Bruges.note: Only active brewery in the historic centre; Brugse Zot, Straffe Hendrik, 3 km beer pipeline, XL rooftop tour.

Bruges.name: De Garre
Bruges.note: Hidden alley café, house tripel at 11%, maximum three per person.

Bruges.name: 't Brugs Beertje
Bruges.note: 300+ bottles, the classic brown bar of Bruges.

Bruges.name: Café Vlissinghe
Bruges.note: Oldest pub in Bruges (1515), bocce court in the garden.

Bruges.name: Le Trappiste
Bruges.note: Vaulted cellar bar with a full Trappist list.

Bruges.name: Bourgogne des Flandres
Bruges.note: Brewery-café on the canal, Flemish red house beer.

Ghent.name: Gruut Stadsbrouwerij
Ghent.note: City brewery using a medieval herb-and-spice mix instead of hops: Blond, Amber, Brown, White, Inferno.

Ghent.name: Dok Brewing Company
Ghent.note: Dok-Noord 4B, 30 taps in a converted metal workshop; Pils 13 is the flagship.

Ghent.name: Stroom Brouwers
Ghent.note: Belgian-American duo bridging Belgian tradition and US craft; Forelstraat taproom.

Ghent.name: De Dulle Griet
Ghent.note: Vrijdagmarkt 50, 500 beers, the shoe-in-the-basket ritual for the house Max.

Ghent.name: Het Waterhuis aan de Bierkant
Ghent.note: Groentenmarkt 9, around 170 beers, canal terrace; house beers Gandavum and Klokke Roeland.

Ghent.name: De Hopduvel
Ghent.note: Beer shop in Dok-Noord, the best take-home selection in the city.

Bamberg.name: Schlenkerla
Bamberg.note: Rauchbier since 1405, beechwood-smoked malt from oak barrels in a medieval vaulted cellar.

Bamberg.name: Spezial
Bamberg.note: The locals' rauchbier — subtler smoke than Schlenkerla.

Bamberg.name: Mahr's Bräu
Bamberg.note: The legendary 'aU' Ungespundetes, naturally carbonated and unfiltered.

Bamberg.name: Fässla
Bamberg.note: Dwarf logo, Zwergla dark lager, brewery tap opposite Spezial.

Bamberg.name: Greifenklau
Bamberg.note: Beer garden with the best view over the city.

Bamberg.name: Keesmann
Bamberg.note: Cult Herren Pils, the counterpoint to all the smoke.

Sokolov.name: Pivovar Permon
Sokolov.note: Komenského 77: mining-country craft brewery, Permon IPA 15°, dark specials, brewery restaurant on site.

Plzeň.name: Pilsner Urquell
Plzeň.note: Where pilsner was born in 1842; cellars tour with unfiltered, unpasteurised tank beer.

Plzeň.name: U Salzmannů
Plzeň.note: Pražská 8, a pub since 1637 and the best-poured tank Urquell in town.

Plzeň.name: Na Parkánu
Plzeň.note: Attached to the brewery, freshest tank Pilsner you will get.

Plzeň.name: Purkmistr
Plzeň.note: Brewery hotel with its own beer spa and a solid dark lager.

Plzeň.name: Pivovar Raven
Plzeň.note: Czech craft pioneer: IPAs, stouts and sours outside the pilsner tradition.

Kout na Šumavě.name: Pivovar Kout na Šumavě
Kout na Šumavě.note: Revived in 2006 from a defunct 19th-century brewery; the 12° pale lager is a cult beer among Czech beer nerds.

Maxlrain.name: Schlossbrauerei Maxlrain
Maxlrain.note: Family-owned castle brewery in Tuntenhausen; Helles, Dunkel and Weißbier served in the Bierstube next door.

Andechs.name: Kloster Andechs
Andechs.note: Benedictine monastery brewery since 1455; Doppelbock Dunkel at 7.1% with a view over the Ammersee.

Andechs.name: Andechser Hof, Herrsching
Andechs.note: Inn and restaurant by the lake, pours the full Andechs range; the practical base for the night.

Munich.name: Augustiner-Keller
Munich.note: Munich's oldest brewery and the locals' choice; Edelstoff from wooden barrels under the chestnuts.

Munich.name: Schneider Bräuhaus
Munich.note: The original wheat-beer house; Aventinus is the benchmark Weizenbock.

Munich.name: Hofbräuhaus
Munich.note: Brewing since 1589 — go once for the room, not for the quiet.

Munich.name: Giesinger Bräu
Munich.note: Garage-to-glory Munich craft brewery; Erhellung unfiltered Helles.

Munich.name: ORCA Brau
Munich.note: Tiny nano-brewery making juicy NEIPAs that rival New England.

Munich.name: Tilmans Biere
Munich.note: Small, refined Munich brewery for a quieter final round.

Munich.name: Paulaner Nockherberg
Munich.note: Historic brewery site above the Isar, home of the Starkbierfest.

Nuremberg.name: Hausbrauerei Altstadthof
Nuremberg.note: Organic brewery since 1984 below the castle; Rotbier, beer schnapps and a single malt.

Nuremberg.name: Schanzenbräu
Nuremberg.note: Family brewery founded 2004 with its own pub in Gostenhof.

Nuremberg.name: Tucher Mautkeller
Nuremberg.note: Medieval vaulted brewhouse serving Tucher Rotbier in the old town.

Nuremberg.name: Zeltner Bierhaus
Nuremberg.note: Rotbier specialist; the beers are brewed elsewhere but the list is the city's deepest.

Nuremberg.name: Bierwerk Wirtshaus
Nuremberg.note: Franconian beer list plus Nuremberg sausages, central and reliable.

days.title: Arrive FRA, drive to Bruges
items: Pick up the rental car at Frankfurt Airport
493 km / 5 h 15 west through Belgium
Check in inside the old town
Evening first pint at De Garre (house tripel, max three)

days.title: Bruges
items: De Halve Maan XL tour incl. the 3 km beer pipeline
't Brugs Beertje for the 300-bottle list
Café Vlissinghe (1515) for the bocce garden
Bourgogne des Flandres on the canal

days.title: Drive to Ghent, brewery quarter
items: 49 km / 44 min
Gruut Stadsbrouwerij tasting (hop-free herb beers)
Dok Noord: Dok Brewing, Stroom Brouwers, De Hopduvel
De Dulle Griet (500 beers) and Het Waterhuis aan de Bierkant

days.title: Long drive to Bamberg
items: 651 km / 6 h 51 — the longest day of the trip
Break at Würzburg or Fulda
Evening at Schlenkerla: the first rauchbier from the oak barrel

days.title: Bamberg brewery crawl
items: Spezial for the locals' rauchbier
Mahr's Bräu for the aU Ungespundetes
Fässla Zwergla, then Greifenklau's beer garden
Klosterbräu (1533) nightcap, Keesmann Herren Pils if there is room

days.title: Into Bohemia: Permon
items: 160 km / 1 h 59 via Bayreuth and Cheb
Pivovar Permon brewery tour on Komenského 77
Dinner in the brewery restaurant; sleep on site

days.title: Sokolov to Plzeň
items: Optional stop in Loket (12 min) or Karlovy Vary (17 min)
Evening tank beer at U Salzmannů (1637)

days.title: Plzeň: birthplace of pilsner
items: Pilsner Urquell cellars tour with unfiltered tasting
Na Parkánu for the freshest tank Pilsner
Purkmistr brewery hotel, Pivovar Raven for Czech craft

days.title: Plzeň to the Bohemian forest
items: Pivovar Kout na Šumavě: the cult 12° lager
Afternoon walk in the Šumava foothills

days.title: Kout to Upper Bavaria
items: 260 km / 3 h 11 via Regensburg (optional 1 h 32 detour)
Schlossbrauerei Maxlrain tour
Dinner in the Maxlrain Bierstube, sleep at the brewery

days.title: Maxlrain to the Holy Mountain
items: Kloster Andechs: Doppelbock Dunkel above the Ammersee
Sleep in Herrsching by the lake

days.title: Andechs to Munich
items: 45 km / 45 min
Augustiner-Keller: Edelstoff from the wooden barrel
Schneider Bräuhaus for Aventinus

days.title: Munich
items: Giesinger Bräu Erhellung
ORCA Brau taproom for NEIPAs
Hofbräuhaus once for the room
Tilmans Biere or Paulaner Nockherberg to finish

days.title: Munich to Nuremberg
items: Hausbrauerei Altstadthof: Rotbier under the castle
Schanzenbräu pub in Gostenhof, Tucher Mautkeller vaults

days.title: Nuremberg to Frankfurt, fly home
items: Return the car at FRA
Last stop: a Tucher or Zeltner Rotbier before security
